lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately five visible horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The spacing between centroids is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral section with a slight increase in inter-blob distance moving posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible rectangular grid-like lattice across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a lower-intensity shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a commensal organism is visible attached to or swimming immediately ventral to the pectoral fin.
